# PixelIndieDev
> Personal website of PixelIndieDev, an indie game developer, modder and null stack developer.
The pages below are markdown versions of the website for AI tools and AI crawlers.

## Pages
- [Home](https://pixelindiedev.github.io/index.md): Overview and social links
- [About Me and Favorite Games](https://pixelindiedev.github.io/aboutme.md): Personal facts and favorite games
- [My Mods](https://pixelindiedev.github.io/mymods.md): Links to all his mods
